page.overview:
Who is Sophia Esteed?

Sophia Esteed is a character from the Star Ocean franchise. She makes a playable appearance as a summonable vision in Final Fantasy Brave Exvius and was introduced as part of the second collaboration with Star Ocean -anamnesis-.

Sophia is the female protagonist of the series' third installment, Star Ocean: Till the End of Time. A young woman born on 28th-century Earth, Sophia is separated from her longtime friend Fayt when an attack on the resort planet of Hyda IV forces an immediate evacuation of the planet. What becomes of her is not known for a large portion of the story.

Sophia is a Global-exclusive 5-7★ Rare Summon, available for summoning during the rerun of Vanquish Jie Revorse! (which ran in January 2019). Her job is listed as Caster, and her role is Magic Damage. She has no innate element or status ailment resistances. Her Trust Master is the Crescent Rod (ATK+28, MAG+135), which grants the passive Connection Symbol when equipped by Sophia. Her Super Trust Master reward is Sophia's Hairpin (MAG+60, SPR+60), which increases the equipped unit's resistance to Fire (+30%) and grants the passive Symbologists' Bond when equipped by Sophia.
